title: Context mapping
activation: work starts inside a system the actor did not build
a wrong assumption about how parts relate would cost real work
standDown: the actor already holds the map
the task is too small to be endangered by a wrong relationship
inputs: the request in the person's own words
the project constitution when one exists
minimumEvidence: every load-bearing claim cites what it rests on or is marked unverified
escalation: an unknown that blocks safe action is raised as a decision, not guessed
